name: The Wronged
tagline: Monsters took everyone you loved, and you have trained for years to kill every last one of their kind. Tough, driven, and built around hunting one type of monster.
luckSpecial: Spending a Luck point turns up a risky lead on whatever you are hunting.

moves.intro: On top of every basic move you get three Wronged moves. I Know My Prey comes automatically; choose two more below.

auto.name: I Know My Prey
auto.summary: Take +1 ongoing whenever you deliberately investigate, chase or fight the type of monster responsible for your loss.

choices.name: Berserk
choices.summary: Pain cannot stop you in a fight: you stay on your feet until it ends. In that time the Keeper cannot use harm moves against you and you cannot die. Once the fight is over, all the harm you took applies normally.

choices.name: NEVER AGAIN
choices.summary: In a fight you can protect someone automatically, as though you had rolled 10+, but you cannot pick the 'suffer little harm' option.

choices.name: What Does Not Kill Me...
choices.summary: Once you have been hurt in a fight, take +1 ongoing for the rest of that fight.

choices.name: Fervor
choices.summary: When you manipulate someone, your roll uses +Tough, not +Charm.

choices.name: Safety First
choices.summary: Your gear has been modified for extra protection: +1 armour, to a maximum of 2-armour.

choices.name: DIY Surgery
choices.trig: When you do quick and dirty first aid on someone (including yourself)
choices.full: Counts as proper first aid, and the wound is also stabilized and 1 harm is healed.
choices.part: Counts as proper first aid, plus one extra effect of your choice from the note.
choices.note: Choose one on a 7-9: the wound is stabilised but the patient has -1 forward; 1-harm is healed and the wound held for now, though it returns later as 2-harm and turns unstable again; 1-harm is healed and held, with the patient at -1 ongoing until proper treatment.

choices.name: Tools Matter
choices.summary: Your signature weapon gives you +1 to kick some ass.

items.name: Specialist weapons for destroying your foes (e.g. wooden stakes and mallet for vampires, silver dagger for werewolves)
items.tags: 4-harm against the creatures it is made for, 1-harm against anything else; other tags by agreement with the Keeper

gear.title: Protective wear
gear.intro: Your look comes with protective clothing worth 1-armour.

items.name: Protective wear, suited to your look

extras.title: Who you lost
extras.intro: Pick one or more of these. The sheet has a blank line after each, so write in who they were.

extras.title: What did it? My prey
extras.intro: Agree a monster breed with the Keeper. That breed is your prey, and it is what took them from you.

extras.title: Why you could not save them
extras.intro: Pick as many reasons as apply for why you failed to save them.

history: This hunter gave you vital help during your search for revenge. Ask yourself what you needed, and tell them.
They blocked your way when you were trying to learn the truth. Ask what their reason was.
They too lost someone to these monsters. Ask who.
You are related, closely or distantly. Tell them exactly how.
You rescued them when they were a hopeless rookie. Ask them what the danger was.
You value their hard-won experience and regularly seek their advice.
They taught you the basics of fighting.
They saw you snap and rampage. Describe the situation, and ask how much damage you did around you.
